name: DeepSeek V4 Flash DSpark — dual Spark, 1M context
statusNote: Unblocked 2026-07-29, not yet baselined. Both hard blockers are gone: the engine serves on stock vLLM 0.26.0 at --block-size 256 via the flashinfer overlay, and multi-node greedy determinism is now MEASURED rather than assumed. What remains is to record a baseline.

blockers.what: Whether greedy token identity survives an NCCL allreduce was unmeasured, and no TP target could be ranked until it was settled.
blockers.answer: It survives. Two boots, TP2 across two Sparks, NCCL over RoCE, warmup discarded: 4/4 prompts byte-identical (see results/_multinode/determinism-2026-07-29.txt). Neither boot hung, which also supports the standing theory that the 07-28 hangs were the TCP-socket fallback rather than a kernel fault.
blockers.sharedWith: glm-5-2-dual-spark-tp2 and every other dual-Spark recipe — this is a property of the collective, not of a model.
blockers.scope: Two boots at 8192 context, one config, four prompts. Enough to make multi-node rankable; the baseline's per-prompt stability screening still applies.

blockers.what: ulimit -l was 8 MB on both nodes, so NCCL could not use RDMA and fell back to TCP sockets. A paired ratio measured over sockets is not the recipe's hardware.
blockers.howFixed: limits.d memlock unlimited on both nodes, verified as unlimited in the launch path itself rather than in a shell.
blockers.trap: The fix READ as failed for a day. Tailscale SSH terminates inside tailscaled and never runs pam_limits, so any ulimit taken over the tailnet reports systemd's 8 MB default no matter what limits.d says. Ray workers inherit whatever launched them, so a cluster started from a tailnet session gets 8 MB memlock on every raylet and NCCL silently falls back to sockets EVEN WITH THE ROOT FIX APPLIED. Launch the head via `ssh localhost` and the worker over its LAN address, and assert unlimited on both inside the script.

blockers.what: oom-guard.sh trips at MemAvailable < 8192 MiB and killed a run that missed by 321 MiB, silently. The 6 GiB KV pin clears it, but the margin is thin and an arena arm must not die mid-measurement.
blockers.nextStep: Either raise the guard for arena runs or keep the KV pin at 6 GiB and verify headroom before each arm.

why: Worth scaffolding despite being blocked: at 1,048,576 tokens of context across two nodes with FP4 experts and FP8 dense, it exercises paths nothing else in the corpus does — and it is the recipe most likely to reward kernel work, because almost nothing on that path was written for sm_121.

served.note: First light, not a benchmark: --max-model-len 8192, NCCL over sockets because memlock is 8 MB, and there is no page-size-64 baseline to compare against because the model cannot run at 64 at all.
